# Synthetic EdgeTAM test clips

These clips reproduce the geometry, frame counts and rotation of the original FermentEngine frame-source fixtures at revision `5a9a51516`. All frames are synthetic. The 48×32 clip has 30 distinct frames and a 90° display rotation. The 16×16 ten-minute clip has 18,000 black frames.
